description: The Sint-Stephanuskerk at Hasselt in Overijssel is a late Gothic brick hall church with a heavy west tower built into the church. The present spire dates from the rebuild after the 1725 fire. It is partly cloudy, about 9.4°C, with wind near 3.2 km/h and cloud cover about 73%. The church is closed. This is not Hasselt in Belgium.
